title: Aloah from Brickwater

description.de: Die erste EP, in einer akustischen Session bei btm-guitars in Nürnberg aufgenommen. Fünf Protestlieder mit Mandoline, Lap Steel und viel Herz.
description.en: The first EP, recorded during an acoustic session at btm-guitars in Nuremberg. Five protest songs with mandolin, lap steel and a lot of heart.

credits: Idea, lyrics, vocals and main guitar: Brickwater
Mandolin, lap steel, electrics and bass: Jens Hold

tracks.title: I Hope You Said What You Needed To Say
